summary: A dark, Awwwards-flagged showcase for a geometric sans by Lit Design Studio and HvD Fonts: hairline-ruled sections with small tracked captions, huge sample words and a long bento of invented artefacts. The fixed bar has a page-wide black/white/colour theme switch.

instances.look: Fixed 80px top bar: 'Graphit — Typeface', Black site / White site radios, triangle-circle-square Color toggle, Contact — Buy; stitched into every crop, together with the cookie bar and an Awwwards ribbon
A five-line left-aligned nonsense sentence on charcoal, each word in another weight or italic, with a long rule standing in for a word break; three pagination dots at the right edge
instances.feel: Storybook sentences as a weight sampler
instances.ux: Fade carousel of three sentences that auto-advances; lines reveal one by one upward; draggable, dots are clickable
instances.learn: Style word by word inside one sentence: the hero shows the whole family with no list, and the rotation gives three chances to read it

reconstruction.layout: Full-width 1440×701 under the 80px bar; container ~1320px, text left at 60px, 5 lines; dots fixed at right, x≈1420, vertical
reconstruction.typography: 96px, leading ~1.13, mixed per word: Thin, Light, Regular, Medium, Bold, Black plus italics; inline rule ~160px replaces a word space (.c-separator--big)
reconstruction.behaviour: Swiper fade effect, autoplay with loop; each .c-reveal_text line slides up inside an overflow mask on slide change; grab cursor; page starts with a ~3s white load
reconstruction.content: Absurd invented tales: 'The wild Squad of hairy Giants — is broiling juicy tofu Sticks over the sizzling Campfire.'

instances.look: Small tracked 'ABOUT GRAPHIT' caption above a 36px paragraph, then an underlined 'More information' link
instances.learn: A one-paragraph about in Regular at 36px doubles as the first text-size specimen

reconstruction.layout: 557px section under a hairline; centred caption, then paragraph spanning ~1300px from x=60, four lines; centred link below
reconstruction.typography: Caption ~13px caps, tracked ~0.15em; paragraph 36px Regular, leading ~1.35
reconstruction.content: 'Graphit is a typeface designed by Lit Design Studio & curated by HvD Fonts…'

instances.look: Right half of a split section: 'SIX WEIGHTS PLUS ITALICS' caption over six lines 'Graphit Black … Thin', each in its weight
instances.learn: A vertical hairline splitting the section in two pairs a detail with a family list at equal rank

reconstruction.layout: 785px split, vertical rule at 720px; list left-aligned at x≈815, six lines
reconstruction.typography: ~66-100px sentence case, leading ~1.2, weight descending line by line

instances.look: Left half: 'CHARACTERISTIC ELEMENT' caption over a mostly blank SVG (a base rule, a wedge) with a '1' drawn from outline strokes; captured mid-animation and covered by the fixed bars
instances.ux: An SVG letter assembles as it scrolls in; barely visible in the capture
instances.learn: Give the typeface's sharp wedge detail its own half-screen drawing rather than a caption

reconstruction.layout: Left half of the split, 720×785; caption at top centre, SVG centred, hairline along the baseline
reconstruction.typography: Caption ~13px caps tracked; SVG <text> 100px in Graphit
reconstruction.behaviour: Assumed reveal on scroll; only the first state was captured
reconstruction.assets: Inline SVG of the wedge detail

instances.look: 'JUST WRITE SOMETHING' caption, one thin row of controls (Weight slider, Size slider, alignment icons, Italic, Alternates dot), then a huge centred Thin sentence
instances.ux: Stepped weight slider (Thin to Heavy names in the tooltip), continuous size slider, toggles for italic and alternates; click the text to edit
instances.learn: A small slider with a word tooltip ('thin') works well for a static family: it shows named steps, not numbers

reconstruction.layout: 1176px section; centred control row ~780px wide at y≈175; editable text centred across ~1000px, wraps to 5 lines
reconstruction.typography: Controls ~13px; text default 13.4rem (134px) Thin, leading ~1.05, centred with hyphenation
reconstruction.behaviour: Discrete weight steps; size sets font-size in rem; Italic toggles the style; Alternates toggles a stylistic set; alignment left/centre
reconstruction.content: 'The fat polite cyclops tirelessly hacks the solid rock to 89 fine pieces.'

instances.look: One round letter sliced into six segments side by side, thinning left to right, each captioned with stem value: Black 200, Bold 162, Medium 126, Regular 92, Light 60, Thin 28
instances.learn: Stack a slice of each weight in a row and print stem units: the weight curve becomes a graphic

reconstruction.layout: 714px section; six light shapes ~190px wide evenly spaced across 1300px; the shapes are ~320px tall; numbers under each
reconstruction.assets: Seven inline SVG curves cut from a glyph

instances.look: 'DISPLAY SIZES': single words stacked and nearly full width, switching weight each line: Great, 893, Quesadilla, bleistift, fashion magazine, 26 fr., Graffiti battle; hand-drawn arrows point at the curves in '26 fr.'
instances.learn: Choose one word per weight whose letters show off the signature shapes, and add one annotated line to teach what to look at

reconstruction.layout: 2740px section, centred words ~1000-1250px wide, ~380px per word, generous vertical gaps
reconstruction.typography: ~200-420px depending on word; Thin to Black; sentence case and figures
reconstruction.content: Everyday multilingual words: Great, 893, Quesadilla, bleistift, fashion magazine, 26 fr., Graffiti battle
reconstruction.assets: One SVG of arc arrows over '26 fr.'

instances.look: 'READING SIZES': note on Medium, Regular and Light, then three columns of Kafka-like German prose at 24px, then the same at 16px labelled 'with Alternates'
instances.ux: Static on desktop; dots on mobile make the columns a swiper
instances.learn: Label each column 'Style — size' in the same small ruled format and pair default forms with text alternates

reconstruction.layout: 1754px section; centred intro 480px wide; three equal columns ~420px with 25px gaps at each of two sizes
reconstruction.typography: 24px and 16px, leading ~1.3; Medium, Regular, Light; labels ~14px with an inline rule
reconstruction.content: Real German narrative text ('So irrte er richtungslos umher…')

instances.look: '+93 LANGUAGES SUPPORTED': 3×4 grid of words in different weights and italics, each with its language in tiny text
instances.ux: Static on desktop, swiper dots on mobile
instances.learn: A fixed grid with varied weights keeps a diacritics wall lively; the small language label doubles as caption

reconstruction.content: Blockchain, Bækørred, Ćevapčići, Compañero, Geithĩkai, Spårfordon, töframaður, Coração, Mahál kitá, szabadidő, Küçük hanım, čas vstávat

instances.look: Split section: 'LIGATURES' with four stacked words in mixed weights (Schifffahrt, Offizier, #nofilter, Pattern) beside 'ALTERNATES' with one huge letter that changes form (a ↔ double-storey a)
instances.ux: The right letter loops between default and alternate; no controls
instances.learn: One huge letter flipping between its two forms says 'alternate' faster than any label

reconstruction.layout: 760px split, vertical rule at 720px; left: four words ~90px; right: single glyph ~320px tall, centred
reconstruction.typography: Words ~100px Light italic / Black / Thin italic / Regular; glyph Black
reconstruction.behaviour: Looping swap between SVG forms, seen in the video
reconstruction.content: Words with ffl, ffi, #, tt ligatures

instances.look: 'FEATURES & SIGNS': 5×3 grid of icon-like tiles, one sample each (aa, 11, ⅞, O₂, m³, №, ¿H, flame, Åã, →→, $£, ∫µ, ordinal, ligature, @) with a small caption
instances.feel: An icon set of OpenType features
instances.learn: One 65px tile per feature, with no boxes, makes a dense feature list scannable

reconstruction.content: Alternates, Tabular Figures, Fractions, Subscripts, Superscripts, Numero, Case sensitive, Symbols, Latin extended, Arrows, Currency, Mathematical, Ordinals, Ligatures
reconstruction.html: cells set the matching feature (ss01, tnum, numr, case, ss09, dlig) via font-feature-settings

instances.look: 'CHARACTER SET SELECTION': 413 small glyphs on a uniform 20-column grid without cell lines
instances.feel: Calm reference after the loud sections
instances.learn: No rules at all: a wide gap and one small size make a selection of 413 glyphs read as texture

reconstruction.content: Basic Latin, figures, extended Latin, ligatures, arrows, symbols in encoding order

instances.look: 'SAMPLES': a 5300px bento of charcoal rounded cards on near-black: S wave of weights, UI button stickers, OK shapes, arrows of words, smartwatch times, 'Book of Stones', Gin No.2 label, a menu price list, 'Mood' with emoji letters, a periodic table, Auguststraße
instances.feel: A brand book for a dozen imaginary clients
instances.learn: Stay monochrome, change the invented subject on every card: a grid can show range without a single photo

reconstruction.layout: Container ~1320px; rows mix 1, 2 and 3 cards with ~12px gaps; cards from 430×430 to 1320×320, radius ~20px on some; full bleed type often clipped by the card
reconstruction.typography: Every weight; card type 16-300px; tiny corner captions ~10px; menus 60px Light with tabular prices
reconstruction.content: Fictional gin, menu, book, watch, buttons, fashion catalogue, street sign, periodic table

instances.ux: BUY goes to hvdfonts.com; trial opens the on-site /form
instances.learn: Circular outline buttons fit a geometric typeface and leave the trial at equal rank to the purchase
